probe.expected:
open Set Function Filter Topology Polynomial Real in
∃ (T : Set ℝ) (S : ℝ → ℕ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ T, (∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (S x) atTop (𝓝 L)) ∧
(∀ x ∈ T, Tendsto (S x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) → ContinuousOn g T) ∧ ¬ ((∀ x ∈ T, ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (S x) atTop (𝓝 L)) ∧
((∀ x ∈ T, Tendsto (S x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) → ContinuousOn g T))
probe.proof:
by
  have hn : ∀ L : ℝ, ¬ Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (𝓝 L) := by
    intro L h
    have hlt : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, (n : ℝ) < L + 1 :=
      h.eventually (Set.isOpen_Iio.mem_nhds (lt_add_one L))
    have hge : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, L + 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) :=
      tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.eventually
        (Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨L + 1, fun _ hy => hy⟩)
    rcases (hlt.and hge).exists with ⟨n, hlt, hge⟩
    exact (not_le_of_gt hlt) hge
  refine ⟨{0}, (fun _ n => (n : ℝ)), (fun _ => 0), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx h
    rcases h.1 with ⟨L, hL⟩
    exact (hn L hL).elim
  · intro h
    rcases h.1 0 (by simp) with ⟨L, hL⟩
    exact hn L hL
